name: Guard status lines tell the truth
prose: every line that tells the user what the deletion guard and OVERDRIVE do — the engine's status line when the guard is switched, the `/overdrive` lines, the desktop footer hint and its glossary, the OVERDRIVE dialog, the safety note and the tour — says what the permission engine really does in that stance: OVERDRIVE turns the deletion guard off, and outside it commands run while deletions ask.
invariant: Every line that tells the user what the deletion guard and OVERDRIVE do says what the permission engine really does in that stance.
